title: Effect of Fixed RC4 Key Bytes on MPPE Biases
summary: MPPE keystream biases have been observed experimentally, but their origin remains unexplained; characterize the effect of fixed RC4 key bytes and explain the biases theoretically.

formal_statement.body: Consider RC4 keystream generation when one or more key bytes are fixed, with the resulting distributions examined for MPPE keystreams. Existing experimental observations include biases in MPPE keystreams, but no theoretical explanation is supplied for how fixed key bytes produce those biases. The open problem is to characterize, under a specified key-byte-fixing pattern, the resulting RC4 keystream distributions and use that characterization to derive a theoretical explanation of the observed MPPE biases.

scope.domain: Structural cryptanalysis of RC4 keystream distributions and biases in MPPE.
assumptions: One or more bytes in an RC4 key are fixed.
parameters: Key-byte-fixing pattern: determines which RC4 key bytes are fixed when examining the keystream distribution
scope.unresolved_remainder: Characterize the resulting RC4 keystream distributions and use the characterization to explain the observed MPPE biases theoretically.

citations.label: Big Bias Hunting in Amazonia: Large-Scale Computation and Exploitation of RC4 Biases

progress.summary: The source proposes investigating the effect of fixing RC4 key bytes and applying the results to provide a theoretical explanation for observed MPPE keystream biases.
